steps.note: Dock to first wipe standoff (4.5 m); step limit 0.0 m is assumed, not scanned, so watch for thresholds.

The 10 N press is assumed, and this pass runs 5 strokes against a stated coverage of strokes 0-2, so confirm the coverage.
Back off 0.1 m before driving so the cloth clears the coolant-wet table.
Short 0.45 m shuffle along the table edge, where free floor is only 0.25 m wide.
Long joint approach (about 54 s), so check the arm path near the table.
Covers strokes 3-5 at an assumed 10 N press, which has not been calibrated on this table.
Back off 0.1 m before driving.
Another 0.45 m shuffle within the narrow free floor along the table.
Joint approach of about 52 s for the final wipe pass.
Final strokes 6-7 at an assumed 10 N press; check that the table is clear before picking the part.
Back off 0.1 m, which finishes the wipe task.
Move 0.38 m to the pick standoff, where free floor is only 0.18 m from the edge.
Gripper opens at the start of the approach and needs at least 0.08 m of opening for the housing.
Grip force is not established because the ledger has no force band for this 3.5 kg housing, so set and verify it before running.
Lift 0.15 m with a 3.5 kg user-stated payload, and watch for slip given the unset grip force and coolant residue.
Retreat to a carry pose that stays under the 2.35 m header while holding the part.
A 5 m carry holding the 3.5 kg housing, so drive gently because the step limit is assumed and grip force is unverified.
No placement surface is specified at way_out, so confirm where the housing should be set down.
Open the gripper only once the part is resting stably.
Return empty to the dock (1.9 m).
